svg.text: Direct-mapped L1: tag lookup, byte storage and miss refill
The diagram follows read_cache.sv: 1024 x 8 data bits, 64 x 7 tags, 64 valid bits, and a held response register.
No write allocation; no dirty lines; no prefetch
Miss refill: 16 independent byte transactions. Direct mapping needs no LRU state.
cache_en=0 bypasses L1. flush at each accepted start clears valid bits and cache counters.
